candidates.failure_scenario: GET /r/gnoland:anything-at-all (Realm not found, fetchRealm falls back to GetPathsListView) and GET /r/gnoland/norender:anything-at-all (ErrClientRenderNotDeclared, fallback to GetDirectoryView) each answer 200, robots index, follow, canonical and og:url https://gno.land/r/gnoland:anything-at-all, the same listing as the bare URL. candidates.summary: A GnowebPath alias keyed /license.md or /Terms still gets the canonical https://gno.land//license.md, a 400. The round-2 dotted-key fix routes only static aliases through the raw key
candidates.failure_scenario: Run gnoweb with -aliases '/license.md=/r/gnoland/pages:p/license' or '/Terms=...'. GET /license.md answers 200, index, follow, with <link rel=canonical> and og:url https://gno.land//license.md, because ParseFromURL(&requested) reads the last segment as File under Path '/'. GET //license.md answers 400 Invalid path. The target /r/gnoland/pages:p/license names https://gno.land/license.md as its canonical, so the chain ends at a 400 and shared links point there. When the realm gives no lead, the title falls back to the bare 'gno.land', since pathName of Path '/' is empty, while /about reads 'about - gno.land'.
candidates.verify_by: same file copied in, go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB3R3_RealmAliasDottedKey -v -count=1: expect canonical https://gno.land/license.md, observe https://gno.land//license.md
candidates.evidence: Head ea1c620f7: '/about status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/about" title="about - gno.land"'; '/license.md status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land//license.md" og:url="https://gno.land//license.md" title="gno.land"'; '/Terms status=200 ... canonical="https://gno.land//Terms"'; '/r/gnoland/pages:p/license ... canonical="https://gno.land/license.md"'; '//license.md status=400 robots="noindex, nofollow" title="Invalid path - gno.land"'. --- FAIL: TestB3R3_RealmAliasDottedKey. TestHTTPHandler_StaticAliasNamedLikeAFile passes, so only the static half is fixed.

candidates.summary: aliasTargets keys an alias by its target's path and args, dropping the $ view, so an alias to $source or $help becomes the bare realm page's canonical
candidates.failure_scenario: Run -aliases '/src=/r/gnoland/pages$source' with no shorter plain alias for that realm. canonicalURL's aliasFor (handler_http.go:1449) then gives GET /r/gnoland/pages, the rendered realm, at 200, index, follow, with canonical and og:url https://gno.land/src, which is the source view. With '/actions=/r/gnoland/home$help', /r/gnoland/home names /actions as canonical, and /actions answers noindex, follow, so search engines are told to replace the realm page with one kept out of the index.
candidates.verify_by: same file copied in, go test ./gno.land/pkg/gnoweb -run TestB3R3_ViewAliasTakesRealmCanonical -v -count=1: expect /r/gnoland/pages canonical https://gno.land/r/gnoland/pages, observe https://gno.land/src
candidates.evidence: Head ea1c620f7: '/r/gnoland/pages status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/src" og:url="https://gno.land/src"'; '/r/gnoland/home status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/actions"'; '/src status=200 robots="index, follow" canonical="https://gno.land/src"'; '/actions status=200 robots="noindex, follow" canonical="" og:url="https://gno.land/actions"'. --- FAIL: TestB3R3_ViewAliasTakesRealmCanonical.
